evidence_items.explanation: The study reports limited autonomous planning performance, including an approximately 12% cross-domain average for GPT-4, alongside more promising assisted approaches. These results do not establish that every LLM-based system lacked the full claimed capability.

LLM+P combines language-model translation with a classical planner and reports successful planning across benchmark domains. This is material counterevidence to excluding all LLM-based systems, but it does not establish reliable performance across the full conversational comparison.

unresolved_gaps: No common reliability threshold or complete SHRDLU-equivalent task suite is specified.
The located studies do not jointly test sustained dialogue, world-state tracking and manipulation across all relevant systems.
Hybrid planning successes make extrapolation from standalone LLM failures unsafe.
